item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://cableteque.com/blog/losing-money-on-cable-assembly-quotes","version_id":"33abdbe4f75624efed189d40297ade0c2f12f250f578435d87954b3c34d4693e","decision":"accept","reason":"Fresh, dated commercial evidence on AI-assisted manufacturing quoting: Cableteque says its system reads drawing and CAD-export inputs, builds a BOM, and flags likely missing connector components and compatibility gaps before pricing. This is relevant to production-ready geometry and manufacturability decisions, but its claimed 60–80% labor-template automation and Resco's reduction from 5+ days to 2–3 days are vendor/customer-reported results; the stated check is operational use by Resco, while disclosed settings, attempt counts, and independent replication are missing. It is therefore usable as an attributed commercial claim and a concrete workflow to scrutinize, not proof that the system reliably detects all drawing omissions.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
